programmes.department: Narendra Paul Loomba Department of Management
programmes.evidence: The official doctoral specialization prepares academic researchers in Operations Research and analytics, explicitly trained by Operations Management faculty in the Narendra Paul Loomba Department of Management. Research areas include healthcare, retail and service operations, revenue management, supply chain management and behavioral operations. The PhD in Business is jointly offered by Baruch College and the CUNY Graduate Center.
limitations: This is one specialization of the joint PhD in Business, not a second standalone degree or a system-wide CUNY programme census.

branches.conclusion: Read the full six-area PhD in Business inventory and the Operations & Decision Analytics specialization. Accountancy, Finance, Information Systems, Management and Entrepreneurship, and Marketing are the other listed areas. The separate DBA is not added under the current scope.

The full college-wide academic inventory covers three schools and lists Financial Engineering at master’s level. It establishes no separate engineering doctoral programme or Industrial Engineering unit at Baruch. Other CUNY colleges remain separate providers.
